snippet.title: CRABS MUST DIE! (2025) Gameplay Trailer | PC | Steam
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3843400/CRABS_MUST_DIE
CRABS MUST DIE! is a tiny open-world shooter full of crabs, raiders, zombies, and robots that hate you
Shoot, loot, blow stuff up, and try not to die.
Summon a useless robot buddy, drink some beer, and fight a giant shrimp.
Made by one dude with zero budget and way too much free time — add it to your wishlist (please).
